description: Create a journal for a business expense paid personally by the owner.

deductible_vat_amount.description: Deductible part of VAT when vat_deduction_mode=partial, or an explicit deductible VAT amount to override the default or configured ratio.

expense_account_dimension_id.description: Dimension ID of the expense account; required when that account has dimensions

payable_account_dimension_id.description: Dimension ID of the payable account (e.g. the owner's own dimension); required when that account has dimensions (e.g. a 2110 split by lender)

vat_amount.description: Exact VAT amount (overrides vat_rate if provided)

vat_deduction_mode.description: VAT deduction mode. Use partial with deductible_vat_amount.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate as decimal (e.g. 0.24 for 24%; 0 only when the document has no VAT). Must be a fraction, NOT a percentage — use 0.24, not 24. For non-deductible VAT keep the document's rate (or pass vat_amount) and set vat_deduction_mode="none": the VAT is then added to the expense and the owner payable.

name: create_owner_expense_reimbursement
title: Book Owner-Paid Expense
